name: Dropdown menu
summary: Floating menu with actions, opened from a Button or Button icon. The items sit in a native Figma slot, so you fill them per use.
use: Secondary actions that do not all need to be visible ("More options").
avoid: Choosing a value for a form: use Select.
Navigation between pages: use links or Nav item.
anatomy: Items (slot): Menu item with icon, label and shortcut.
figmaProps: Menu item: Label / Icon leading / Leading icon / Show shortcut / Shortcut
reactProps: { label, icon?, shortcut?, destructive?, disabled?, onSelect }[] | { type: 'separator' }
behaviour: Opening moves focus to the first item. Arrow up/down, Home and End move the focus.
Escape or a choice closes the menu and moves focus back to the trigger.
a11y: The trigger has aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The menu has role="menu", items have role="menuitem".
content: Labels start with a verb. Destructive actions go at the bottom, after a divider.
do: Group related actions with a separator.
